best_image.alt_text: Watercolor and graphite on paper. A white lighthouse tower stands on an outcropping of land overlooking a calm body of water. In the background, a full moon shines brightly in a dark sky. A path leads from the bottom right of the image to the door of the lighthouse. Green trees surround the base of the lighthouse. In the bottom right corner of the work is text that reads "G.T.O.K."

Graphite on paper. A sculpture or cast of a hand, unattached to a body, rests on a flat surface denoted by a single, horizontal line. The fingers are gently curled inwards, with the palm facing down and the ring finger slightly raised. The artist's signature, "G. O'Keeffe," is visible in the bottom right corner of the sketch.

Watercolor on paper. A glass vase containing two branches stands on a flat, beige-colored surface. The vase is positioned in the left third of the image. The branches are covered in green leaves, brown thorns, and bright red flowers in full bloom. The background of the image is painted in shades of light gray and tan.
best_image.credit: Courtesy of Georgia O'Keeffe Museum. Photo: Tim Nighswander/IMAGING4ART

best_image.alt_text: Watercolor on paper. A green ceramic teapot overflowing with bright yellow flowers sits on a tan-colored surface, with a small matching ceramic lid resting next to it. Light emanates from the left side of the watercolor, hitting the flowers and teapot, which cast a shadow that runs to the right edge of the image. A dark background is rendered in shades of brown and gray.
best_image.credit: Courtesy of Georgia O'Keeffe Museum. Photo: Tim Nighswander/IMAGING4ART

best_image.alt_text: Sketch of the artist's sister's head and shoulders in profile. Image is in the center of the paper surrounded by negative space on all sides. The subject is facing towards the right side of the paper, with her head tilted slightly downward toward her chest. Her hair is in a loose braid and the collar of her shirt is lightly drawn in. The negative space which defines the area around the face is darkly shaded.

Graphite sketch of young boy with hat, focused in center of the paper. The upper body of a boy is drawn in profile, facing left, his hands  clasped behind his lower back. The area immediately surrounding  the figure is shaded. Signed and dated, lower right hand corner of paper.

Graphite sketch showing full body of a young girl (the artist's sister) in profile. The drawing is focused in the center of the paper surrounded by negative space. The girl is wearing a bow in her short hair and a knee length dress. She is wearing shoes which have been heavily shaded in. The leg in the foreground is slightly bent. Signed and dated, lower right hand corner.

Graphite sketch of a girl ( the artist's sister) with a hat. The drawing is located slightly to the lower right of the center of the paper and is surrounded by negative space. The girl is drawn in profile, from the lower legs on up. Her hands are clasped in front of her and she is looking downward, facing the left side of the paper. She has a braid in her hair and a large bow on her hat that is heavily shaded. She wears a knee length dress with a bow around the midsection. Signed and dated, lower right hand corner.

Graphite sketch of young girl (the artist's sister) with a bow in her pulled back hair, facing forward, head partially turned to the left, looking downward. Figure is drawn in the center of the paper surrounded by negative space, some shading against profile. Shoulders and top of blouse lightly drawn. Signed directly beneath lower right of the drawing.

best_image.alt_text: Watercolor and graphite on paper. Dark branches loaded with white cherry blossom-like flowers stand in a glass mason jar. The jar sits on a white surface against a gray background. Loose, expressive brushstrokes make up the composition.
best_image.credit: Courtesy of Chazen Museum of Art at the University of Wisconsin.

best_image.alt_text: Graphite sketch of young man's head (the artist's brother) in profile, facing toward the left side of the paper. Drawing positioned in center of paper surrounded by negative space, light shading against the profile. Signed and dated directly below lower right of drawing.

Graphite sketch of the head of a young woman (the artist's sister) in profile, facing toward the left side of the paper. The head is positioned sllightly to the right of the center of the paper and  is surrounded by negative space. The area immediately behind the neck is shaded and the shoulders are lightly sketched in. Dated and signed directly beneath the lower right of the drawing.

Graphite sketch of a bust, a man with a beard and long flowing hair.The bust shows the head chest and shoulders of the man mounted on a short pedestal. The image is positioned in the center of the paper and the bust is positioned so that it faces slightly leftward.

Graphite sketch showing bust of a young man. The bust is done in the classical style, the man is shown with a wreath in his hair and a drape that clasps together over the shoulder on the left side and extends across the chest to wrap over the shoulder on the right. A strap is also shown extending from the shoulder on the left down to the torso. The drawing is positioned in the center and fills most of the space on the paper. The bust is looking off towards the right side of the paper.

Graphite drawing of bust of young child. Drawing positioned horizontally in the center of the paper.The bust is positioned so that it is lying on its back, its face turned towards the top of the paper, the top of the head pointing toward the right side of the paper.Signed directly beneath the drawing on the lower right.
Graphite drawing of bust of young child. Bust is positioned vertically in the center of the paper surrounded by negative space. Signed directly beneath the right arm.

Graphite sketch of a young girl, one of the artist's sisters. The girl is seated on a flat surface, with her hands placed in her lap. She is positioned in the center of the page, her head and body are facing slightly towards the left of the page. The girl is wearing a dress and has jaw-length hair, her expression is serious. The negative space that surrounds the figure on the left side of the page is heavily shaded, the negative space that surrounds the figure on the right side of the page is lightly shaded.

best_image.credit: Courtesy of Memorial Art Gallery of the University of Rochester.

best_image.alt_text: Oil on canvas. A young girl with brown eyes and short brown hair looks out at the viewer at the center of this oval-shaped composition. The girl wears a white shirt or dress with a square neckline.

best_image.alt_text: Monotype on paper. A woman in a long, white smock stands painting at an easel. Only the back of the easel is visible to the viewer. Light streams in from the right side of the painting, illuminating the woman's white smock. The rectangular print sits at the center of the composition, framed by plain white paper.
best_image.credit: Courtesy of Chazen Museum of Art at the University of Wisconsin.

best_image.alt_text: Bird's-eye view of a still-life on a lightly-colored flat surface.  The still-life includes a red horse wearing a saddle and bridle in the lower right corner and a yellow plate with a round green item on it in the left central portion of the scene.  A darker stripe of horizontal color forms the upper boundary of the work.
best_image.credit: Courtesy of Georgia O'Keeffe Museum. Photo: Tim Nighswander/IMAGING4ART

best_image.alt_text: Charcoal on paper. In this abstract composition, several thin, white forms grouped around the center of the work curl downward like stamens surrounding the center of a flower. Thin white lines appear to support a small, shining black oval, raising it above the level of the stamens. An arch rendered in shades of black and gray frames the black shape.
best_image.credit: Courtesy of National Gallery of Art.

best_image.alt_text: Charcoal on paper. Thin, amorphous strips run vertically up and down the abstract composition. The strips have organic, soft forms that resemble a substance melting over the paper.
best_image.credit: Courtesy of National Gallery of Art.

best_image.alt_text: Charcoal on paper. Two long, thin shapes that curve downward at their tops hover at the center of the canvas. Rippling stripes float on either side of the thin forms. All of the elements are drawn in shades of gray and black and contrast with the plain white surface of the paper surrounding them.
best_image.credit: Courtesy of National Gallery of Art.

best_image.alt_text: Charcoal on paper. A gray form rises from the bottom to the top of the composition, then curls downward at the top. A shadow-like shape echoes the larger form. These elements sit against a plain white background.
best_image.credit: Courtesy of National Gallery of Art.

best_image.alt_text: Charcoal on paper. Softly rendered stripes of white and gray run vertically over the work. A large black form echoes this vertical path, then curls downwards at the top.
best_image.credit: Courtesy of National Gallery of Art.

best_image.alt_text: Charcoal on paper. A spiral form with a long tail sweeps upward through the composition. The form, with layers of white, gray, and black, circles in on itself. The form contrasts with the plain white, exposed surface of the paper surrounding it.

Charcoal on paper. In this abstract composition, a striped, black, white, and gray form sweeps upward from the bottom of the canvas and curls in on itself at the top. The form resembles the scroll of a violin or a sweeping piece of draped fabric.

Charcoal on paper. Two bird-like forms curl around a central circular shape. Behind these elements are cloud shapes at the top right corner of the work as well as small rectangular strips at the bottom right and top left of the image. The rest of the background has been shaded dark gray.
best_image.credit: Courtesy of National Gallery of Art.

best_image.alt_text: Charcoal on paper. A large, circular form fills the frame. Within the form are two rectangular strips running vertically along the composition. A few semicircular shapes, fused together, occupy the righthand side of the page. Rippling lines that resemble steam rise from the semicircular forms. These black shapes stand out from the shaded gray background behind them.
best_image.credit: Courtesy of National Gallery of Art.

best_image.alt_text: Charcoal on paper. Several undulating black lines run diagonally from the bottom left to the center-right edge of the composition. Running parallel to these lines is a strip of dark gray punctuated by small black rectangles. Light gray, billowing forms dominate the upper half of the composition, punctuated by soft, darker gray shapes that resemble drops of water.

best_image.alt_text: Charcoal on paper. A pale, twisting tree stands on a bit of land overlooking a dark expanse of water. The tree is bare and juts into a plain gray sky. Expanding across the sky is a large, abstract form that resembles the simplified shape of a bird flying in the distance.
best_image.credit: Courtesy of Amon Carter Museum of American Art.

best_image.alt_text: Charcoal on paper. In this semiabstract composition, a tall, thin form sweeps upwards from the bottom of the canvas. The shape is narrow at its top but expands outwards near the bottom of the composition, like a tree widening as it meets the earth. At the top of the form are dark, geometric shapes that resemble clusters of leaves attached to the branches of a tree. Behind the tree-like element are white and gray lines that ripple beneath rectangular bands of gray, echoing the patterns of undulating waves beneath a glowing sky.
best_image.credit: Courtesy of National Gallery of Art.

best_image.alt_text: A large, dark-colored blanket hangs across much of the upper portion of the image, with soft folds flowing off to the right. A second blanket comprised of alternating black and white horizontal stripes of various sizes descends from the upper-left corner across much of the lower portion of the drawing.  It lies in heavier folds than the darker blanket on its right.  A small patch of dark color is exposed in the lower-left portion of the drawing, forming a contrast to the striped blanket that it borders.
best_image.credit: Courtesy of Georgia O'Keeffe Museum. Photo: Tim Nighswander/IMAGING4ART

best_image.alt_text: Vertical charcoal drawing on paper with curving lines that sweep from top right to bottom lower left.  One quite small dark half moon shape in middle right, while other shades are lighter greyish.
best_image.credit: Courtesy of Georgia O'Keeffe Museum. Photo: Tim Nighswander/IMAGING4ART

best_image.alt_text: Charcoal on paper. Thin black stripes run diagonally from the bottom left corner to the top right of the composition. A large, textured semicircular form fills much of the composition, extending from the bottom into the top third of the paper. Six dark gray, square shapes are distributed around the upper right portion of the image.
best_image.credit: Courtesy of National Gallery of Art.

best_image.credit: Courtesy of National Gallery of Art.

best_image.alt_text: Vertical watercolor on paper of very simple calligraphic black thin lines. There is a thick stroke along the bottom edge, with two delicate lines growing out. best_image.alt_text: Graphite sketch of house and landscape at top of the paper, with writing beneath, occupying the center of the page. Writing takes up more space on the paper than the drawing of the house and landscape.

Watercolor sketch of houses and landscape. There are two houses, the one that is slightly larger is located closer to the left side of the paper, the smaller house is closer to the right side of the paper. The houses are situated slightly above the center of the paper and the front of the paper is dominated by an expanse of light green which fades to yellow as it gets nearer to the houses. In the background, behind the houses, there are dark blue mountains. There is a strip of sky which is white, tinged with blue around the edges of the paper.

best_image.alt_text: Abstract graphite sketch of sleeping girl. Drawing is contained within the top half of the paper. Below is negative space.

best_image.alt_text: Watercolor sketch of head and chest of boy facing forward. The boy has black hair and dark complexion. He wears a jacket painted in yellows and greens and a striped shirt peeks out at the collar. His eyes are slightly downcast, the background is a wash of varying shades of tan.
best_image.credit: Courtesy of Georgia O'Keeffe Museum. Photo: Tim Nighswander/IMAGING4ART

best_image.alt_text: Watercolor sketch of a girl's head and shoulders, facing forward. Her gaze is aimed directly at the viewer.
best_image.credit: Courtesy of Georgia O'Keeffe Museum. Photo: Tim Nighswander/IMAGING4ART

best_image.alt_text: Graphite sketch of a landscape. There is a mountain in the background and several small bumps, representing straw piles, in the foreground. This image dominates the top half of the paper, the bottom half of the paper contains O'Keeffe's writing about the colors of the scene.

Graphite sketch of a landscape. Simple line drawing, no shading. A large hill formation in the foreground, a smaller, more level one in the background. Graphite sketch of a landscape. Simple line drawing, no shading. Abstracted form, moves the eye diagonally across the paper. Large, bulky form in the upper right hand corner of the paper tapers down to a narrow pathway at the bottom right of the paper.

Graphite sketch of a landscape. Simple line drawing, no shading. Composition composed of a large hill on the right which extends down and across the width of the paper, this movement is mimicked by a smaller hill behind the large one. In the distance the horizon is visible.

Graphite sketch of a hill. Simple line drawing, no shading. A single line drawn diagonally across the paper begins in the upper right hand area of the paper and descends to the middle left of the paper.

best_image.alt_text: Painting. Rounded forms in cool mint and laurel green, topaz, and cobalt blue flare outward from a dark blue teardrop shape near the top center of this composition and envelop an inverted teardrop shape, in mauve pink, below the first. The rounded, flaring forms extend off all four sides of the composition. The dark blue teardrop is surrounded by a wide ring of aquamarine blue around the top that lightens to seafoam green below. Bands flare out and up, creating peaks to either side of this ring in the same jewel-toned greens and blues. Two larger forms swell out surround the pink teardrop below. A vertical line extends from the lower teardrop to the bottom edge of the painting, splitting the two forms there. Those forms have smaller lobes above the teardrop and are wider below, like bottom-heavy kidney beans. The areas closest to the pink teardrop are frosty green, darkening to spruce and teal green at the edges. Along the top of the composition, the background deepens from shell pink near the flower to dusky-rose pink at the edge. Darker pink fills in the lower corners. Brushstrokes are visible in some areas and more blended in others.
best_image.credit: Courtesy of Georgia O'Keeffe Museum. Photo: Tim Nighswander/IMAGING4ART

Painting. Two pieces of vivid green fruit sit in a burgundy-red basket, which hovers over or sits on a doily-like form against a carnation-pink field below. The painting is created with mostly flat areas of color, though there is some shading to create a sense of volume in the fruit and basket. The bottom ends of the shamrock-green pears face upward. They sit side-by-side in a long, narrow basket. The handle curves up from the narrow ends. The outside of the basket is dark red, the inside navy blue. The doily beneath the basket has a scalloped edge. The pink surface below fills the bottom half of the painting and is mottled with a darker shade of pink in the bottom right corner and to our left of the doily.

best_image.alt_text: Oil on canvas. A large, pale pink tulip sweeps across the canvas. One of its petals has begun to fall, revealing a bright yellow and green center. A rippling, leaflike form in shades of green, yellow, and blue runs diagonally along the lefthand side of the canvas.

best_image.alt_text: Vertical canvas of mostly white, grey, and black. best_image.alt_text: Oil on canvas. A dark line runs through the center of a plain, purplish gray surface. A white, curved form pokes into the composition in the upper right corner.

best_image.alt_text: Oil on canvas. A central, rounded form dominates the composition. Running through the center of the composition from top to bottom is a thin strip of white similar to a crack in a mirror.
